notes: COALESCE is NULL only when EVERY argument is. `a` ends in a NOT NULL column of the join's preserved side, `b` ends in a literal, and `c` has nothing but nullable arguments. Getting `c` right rules out the shortcut 'COALESCE is never NULL'; getting `a` right rules out 'COALESCE has a nullable argument, therefore nullable'.
